messages:
alex: FYI CI went red on main after merging #4201 — a bunch of ubuntu-latest wheel jobs failing with ImportError: libssl.so.1.1 not found. The PR updated Pipfile.lock. cc @maya @jeff
ci-bot: job matrix/ubuntu-wheels (id: 8421) failed — https://ci.internal/jobs/8421 logs attached
maya: saw the failures. quick guess: cryptography wheel now requires openssl1.1. can you paste the small error block?
alex: here is the tail of the failing test run:
```
ImportError: /usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/libssl.so.1.1: cannot open shared object file: No such file or directory
  File "/opt/venv/lib/python3.8/site-packages/cryptography/hazmat/bindings/openssl/../.."
```
jeff: hmm, that screams a transitive bump to cryptography/pyopenssl. #4201 must've bumped the lock. re-run won't fix the base image. @olga can you try a local lock regen and a quick pin?
olga: starting a pipenv lock locally now. I can run the ubuntu wheel subset in the matrix to confirm. If it's cryptography, we can try pinning to a known-good 3.4.x in a hotfix branch.
alex: i'd prefer a bisect on Pipfile.lock commits to find exactly which change introduced the bump instead of blind revert. range: a4b2c9d -> HEAD. @maya can you run a quick git-bisect script?
maya: yeah i can. plan: `git bisect start --bad HEAD --good a4b2c9d` then run `./ci/scripts/run-wheels.sh ubuntu-latest` as the test. will limit to one job to keep it fast.
ci-bot: rerun requested by @olga for job 8421 — queued
olga: quick note from `pipenv lock` diff: new lock resolves `cryptography==40.0.0`, old lock had `cryptography==3.3.2`. that explains the libssl mismatch. i'm going to try forcing `cryptography==3.4.8` in a temp branch and run the ubuntu matrix.
jeff: if pinning fixes it, we should push a short-term pin and open a follow-up to update base images or rebuild manylinux wheels. also add an infra note so this doesn't surprise other PRs.
olga: pinned to 3.4.8 on a temp branch and kicked the ubuntu-wheels subset — green so far. creating PR with the pin + CI comment explaining why.
alex: nice. can you post the PR and include the CI passes? also ping infra/ops to schedule base image rebuild with openssl1.1 compat or rebuild our manylinux images.
olga: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/4275 — hotfix pin for cryptography + CI guard. tests in the matrix: ubuntu subset green, mac/windows unaffected.
maya: moving forward: i'll draft a short CI guard rule that flags cryptography major upgrades on ubuntu images until images are updated. will open as a draft PR.
alex: thanks all. filing follow-up INF-3123 to track base image rebuild, and we'll merge the hotfix once code owners approve. resolving triage here. :thumbsup:
ci-bot: noted — pipeline reruns and PR links recorded.
